result.title: PROCESS OVERVIEW
result.summary: The PRI’s Limited Partners Private Equity Responsible Investment DDQ was launched in 2015 and adopted by ILPA within its broader DDQ. As ESG practices and LP expectations in private equity have evolved, PRI synchronised its 2021 update with ILPA’s DDQ update. In early 2021, PRI formed a signatory working group to gather industry feedback. Over four months, LPs and GPs submitted written and verbal comments, which were discussed and incorporated where appropriate. This collaboration informed the ESG DDQ in Section 19 of the ILPA DDQ and enabled its public comment period. PRI welcomes further feedback and will consider it according to ILPA’s process.

result.title: APPENDIX
result.summary: An appendix lists 31 investment firms, pension funds, public institutions, and other organizations alongside their named contacts. Organizations include AlpInvest Partners, AP6, Apax Partners, APG, Apollo Global Management, Ardian, Ares Management, Bridgepoint, CalPERS, CalSTRS, CDC Group, Cinven, CVC Capital Partners, EQT, EIF, HarbourVest Partners, Harvard Management Company, Helios Investment Partners, HKMA, ICG, Investindustrial, KKR, LACERA, Neuberger Berman, New Mountain Capital, Oak Hill Capital Partners, Permira, Stafford Capital Partners, StepStone Group, TPG & Y Analytics, and USS. Most have one contact; Ardian, EQT, HKMA, and TPG & Y Analytics list two each.
